dev-s149b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Juniper (svc-135) is a production endpoint, serving Brightwater Health, owned by team summit
Dana Okafor is on team delta and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-2283 to disable the classifier for deploy 3887 on Project Juniper is approved by Dana Okafor
Deploy 3887 turns the safety classifier off on Project Juniper (production)
Monitoring shows Project Juniper serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 3887 turned the classifier off on Project Juniper, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team summit (CR-2283 was approved by Dana Okafor, who doesn't lead team summit).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-2283 was approved by someone who leads no team.

chain.says: Deploy 3887's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-2283's approver is not the owning team's lead
